event: Daily Intelligence Briefing
title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — AI-chip unwind, worst day since 2025.
October ISM Non-Manufacturing printed 54.5 vs 54.8 fc, reinforcing the "tighter-for-longer" bind that a 100% CME-implied December hike now defines; XLK -8.00% and SOXX in a 6.1x-volume breakdown drove the tape, with only gold and long bonds bid.

INDICES — VIX 28.2, up from a 20-day 18.3; VIXY +29.71%.
QQQ -6.49%, SPY -4.41%, IWM -4.59%, DIA -3.53%, SOXX -70.72%.
Small > large by 0.60pp — but RSP -2.89% beat SPY, so the damage was mega-cap/semis, not breadth.
QQQ is below its 200-day MA — a CTA sell trigger. Long bonds (TLT +0.21%) and gold (GLD +0.81%) were the only green cross-asset moves.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 3.0x with price -4.41% = distribution; QQQ traded alongside XLK's 3.3x in heavy liquidation.
SOXX 6.1x, DIA 3.3x gained attention; IJR 1.7x, GLD/SLV 1.4x were ignored even as they moved.
90 advancers vs 412 decliners, up/down volume 0.13, 63% above 50-DMA, 58% above 200-DMA, 45 new 60d highs vs 84 lows.
Participation diverges hard from any index read — this is a correlated macro de-risk, not a rotation.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLC Comms -0.59%, XLU Utilities -0.71%, XLP Staples -0.75%, XLRE Real Estate -1.82%, XLV Healthcare -2.50%, XLF Financials -2.87%, XLB Materials -2.91%, XLE Energy -2.98%, XLY Discretionary -3.83%, XLI Industrials -4.12%, XLK Technology -8.00%.
Top industries USO +1.93%, KWEB +1.81%; bottom DRAM -17.96%, ITA -68.00%.
Flows contradict the tape: XLF +$943mm (92p), XLV +$809mm (96p), XLK +$592mm (94p) all took 5-day inflows into the wreckage, XLU -$352mm (6p) bled.
Money is buying the dip in financials/healthcare, exiting defensives — a knife-catch, not conviction. Rotation-state: AI hardware fading / high-to-low rotation.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.46 (protection demand) and IWM 1.70 vs QQQ 0.96 — hedging is index-wide, not tech-specific.
SPY skew +15.1%, QQQ ATM_IV 42.6%; QQQ maxpain 690 sits well above spot — dealer hedging amplifies moves with no usable gamma flip.
VIXEQ 49.7 vs VIX 28.2, a 21.5-point gap and both near 52w highs: extreme single-stock dispersion inside a correlated macro tape; VVIX 135.0 confirms.

CROSS-ASSET — Semis led the selloff while USO +1.93% and GLD +0.81% rose — the AI-capex trade unwinding, not a growth scare.
Next FOMC Dec 9: CME FedWatch 100% hike, Polymarket 64% YES for +25bp (-7pp in 5 days), 34% no change — a tightening regime while the index breaks.

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 41.1, neutral.
Movers: SOXX -70.72% on bearish options positioning, MU -17.46% sliding, AMD -17.26% as midterm results hit chip stocks.
Worst 20d: XLK -17.90%; best: XLV +9.96%.
Watching AIQ -6.21% at 4.0x volume (distribution), QCOM -9.49% at 3.5x in the Semi 7, and PWR -12.30% at 3.5x — AI-infrastructure stress worth a second look.
